description: This file provides error handling support for the ADODB database abstraction layer using PEAR_Error. It includes functions to handle errors, store the last error, and configure error reporting specific to PEAR integration.

classes.name: PEAR_Error
classes.description: Class representing errors returned by PEAR-based error handling.

methods.name: ADODB_Error_PEAR
methods.description: Function to handle database errors with PEAR support, generating error messages based on context.

methods.name: ADODB_PEAR_Error
methods.description: Function to return the last PEAR_Error object encountered.
